description:
Group 11 Field maple, Silver birch, Common hawthorn Crown Lift Over Car Park/ Footpath to 2.5m - Branch low over parking space.
T14 Common yew Crown Reduce in Height by Specified Amount & Shape Reduce branch lengths by 1m on the northern side of the crown. Height
to remain the same. Crown will be 3m in diameter after works.
T24 Japanese maple Prune to Clear structure/wires/buildings by specified amount Prune to clear cross.
T36 Pedunculate oak Remove Dead Wood - Major deadwood on the north west and south east side.
street_name: Richmond Road leading to Orleans Road
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
site_name: St Mary's Church of England Primary School,
